policy: All expansions remain disabled until artwork is approved and independent device QA is recorded. This file is preparatory; the current public app has Captain, Haiku and Vault excluded.

captain.comment: Never enable on public TeddyVerse before full Captain reskin; do not alter original Fiends without explicit request.

haiku.comment: Include Compose, Zen Garden, Journal, meditation, post-card and character outfits.

vault.comment: Separate 311-file collection originally excluded from first 72; do not bulk-generate without a separate vault signoff.

note: Expansion flags remain OFF in production; the isolated builder runs --enforce before allowing a flag to activate.
